title: Enchilada Delight Casserole
description: A flavorful casserole combining enchilada sauce and umami cheese, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Cook tortillas according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat enchilada sauce over medium heat.
In a separate skillet, heat black beans, diced tomatoes, and chopped cilantro over medium heat.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce on the bottom.
Arrange 2-3 tortillas on the bottom of the dish, overlapping them slightly.
Spoon half of the bean and tomato mixture over the tortillas.
Sprinkle with half of the shredded cheese.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
